title: Fresh EGFR Gate3 validation with bounded omitted-result recovery
scope: Run one new EGFR attempt from Gate1 through a validated Gate3 decision card on the frozen omitted-result recovery code; do not approve Gate3.
precedence: This addendum governs only EGFR r6. Base-cohort and prior EGFR attempts remain immutable audit records.

parent_addendum.disposition: Retained as the immutable record of a rejected cross-fingerprint r5 resume; no model or scientific state was changed by that attempt.

change_boundary.recoverable_input: Only an omitted ref (null/missing), the literal display label full_result, or a hash-shaped unissued handle receives bounded repair feedback.
change_boundary.repair_output: Return at most the recent result handles already issued to the same project thread, role and execution; do not read evidence and do not choose a replacement.
change_boundary.hard_boundaries: Foreign, stale, cross-role, cross-thread, cross-execution, unregistered-file and tampered references remain fatal. Judge authority is not widened.
change_boundary.scientific_effect: None: the repair changes only tool-argument navigation and cannot create, alter, rank or approve scientific evidence.

execution.goal: Design a VHH nanobody against the human EGFR ectodomain that is intended to inhibit ligand-driven receptor activation.

freshness_contract.project_state: Use a never-before-existing r6 project, thread, run ID and runtime-state path. Do not resume or copy r2-r5 state.
freshness_contract.tracked_tree: Clean at attempt start except the pre-existing protected untracked audit, which remains byte-untouched.
freshness_contract.failed_attempts: Retain r2-r5 projects and logs unchanged for audit.

required: current Design proposal and Gate3 decision card exist
compiled design artifacts pass size and SHA verification
no Gate3 response or design approval exists
no Pilot, handoff, generation or StrategyBundle event/path exists
